speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing acute diarrhea; to help me determine the cause, please tell me how long you have had these symptoms and if there has been any fever or blood in your stool.

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: *Clostridioides difficile* infection (C. diff).

The patient is on levofloxacin, which increases the risk of this condition. I am requesting a C. diff toxin assay and stool culture to confirm. REQUEST TEST: C_diff_toxin_assay, C_diff_stool_culture
